charter_basis: DRAFT-004 §6 B-01 admission discipline; §9.2 post-freeze clauses 1-2. Reveal authorization is an act, not an observation.

bound_execution_freeze.re_verified_before_this_decision: All four values re-measured from the working tree and the object store. The decision proceeds only because all four matched.

bound_prior_commitment.note: These are the values the reveal will be checked against. They were fixed before the bridge existed and are not editable by anything that happens next.

authorizes_exactly: requesting the exact previously committed B-01 bytes
verifying exact byte count and SHA-256 against the prior commitment
admitting the bytes as B-01 only after the commitment check passes
does_not_authorize: semantic redesign in response to the revealed case
expectation selection before commitment verification succeeds
why_reveal_is_not_execution: Seeing the case and running the case are different acts with different gates. After a successful commitment check the case stops being blind to us, but the bridge and both freezes stay immutable, and execution still requires a separate Founder EXECUTION GO after both expectations are committed.
